summary: Verified bug fix (floating toolbar with Download PDF visible on dark edition) and new Sakura cherry-blossom edition. All 7 required tests pass: root->/master-chart.html redirect works; dark toolbar shows download-pdf-btn, print-pdf-btn, sakura-edition-link (all visible with correct data-testid); dark Download PDF links to /SAURABH-Master-Chart-Dark.pdf (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 192,122 bytes) with download attribute; Sakura page renders with SAURABH hero, 4 identity chips, 9-row planetary table, house cards, cherry-blossom SVGs; Sakura toolbar shows download-pdf-btn -> /SAURABH-Master-Chart-Sakura.pdf (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 185,641 bytes), print-pdf-btn, dark-edition-link; cross-navigation works both ways; page is scrollable past toolbar (body 1123px vs vp 1080px).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static documents at /master-chart.html (dark) and /master-chart-sakura.html (sakura). PDFs pre-rendered at /SAURABH-Master-Chart-Dark.pdf and /SAURABH-Master-Chart-Sakura.pdf. Toolbar data-testids: download-pdf-btn, print-pdf-btn, sakura-edition-link (dark) / dark-edition-link (sakura). Toolbar hidden in @media print by design.
